newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Electrafina says no decision on Tractebel.
newsitem.headline: Electrafina says no decision on Tractebel.

text.p: Belgium's Electrafina SA, in which holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL) has a participation, said on Tuesday it had considered whether to sell its share in multinational utility Tractebel, but no decision had been made.
"No decision has however been taken up to now," it said in a statement.
Electrafina said in the brief statement it was responding to newspaper articles in the Belgian press on Tuesday.

The Financieel Economische Tijd said GBL and affiliated companies were offering their stake in Tractebel to fellow Belgian holding Societe Generale de Belgique (SGB) at 14,500 francs per Tractebel share.

The other parties mentioned in the article were either unavailable or unable to confirm the report. An SGB spokesman gave no comment but said that GBL was expected to release a statement later on Tuesday.
SGB has a 32.67 percent direct stake in Tractebel. The GBL group including Electrafina has a 20.3 percent stake.
